headline: Clean: World Blue ($300 to the referrer) is the unique highest referrer bonus that a $30,000 business deposit qualifies for.
solution_check: Earliest checking opened 11/10/2023, so tenure exceeds every threshold. Referrer bonuses within $30,000: World Blue $300 ($25k), Lime Green $200 ($15k), Hunter Green $175, Sky Blue $150, Cobalt Blue $150, Navy Blue $100. True Blue ($50k) and Beige ($100k) are out. The last referral (10/30) is outside the 9-day window, and World Blue's annual cap of 12 is unused. That matches gold[4], and the gold replays cleanly.
prior_note: The prior review also rated this task clean; the v1.0.1 edits to beige_012, sky_blue_001 and true_blue_002 are cosmetic placeholder fixes that do not change the answer.
notes: doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_007 says 'refer other international businesses to World Blue', but world_blue_001's referral eligibility has no international requirement, so a careful agent may hesitate without changing the answer. The script tells the user not to question the name. get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is a gold-required discoverable read, which the tenure check needs anyway.
